interpretation: Different schedules need not have identical intermediate fibres or final witnesses. Each run uses the original driver to check saved domains, input relations, reconstruction choices and traces against independent original-graph references, with the per-case coverage in preservation. Full Cartesian bucket equality is separately tested on small graphs. Peak frontier is over completed records only; peak_attempted_frontier includes interrupted joins. Limits are inconclusive. Planning is included in solver time but excluded from relation checks. No universal speed claim.
